n_jobs.title: N Jobs
n_jobs.description: number of cores used to run the pipeline and 2*n_jobs +1 of regions that should be stored in cache. If memory consumption of pipeline is too high reduce this number, if a lot of RAM is available increase this number to decrease runtime

dir_output.title: Dir Output
dir_output.description: name of the directory where the output files will be written

write_intermediate_steps.title: Write Intermediate Steps
write_intermediate_steps.description: if true, writes the oligo sequences after each step of the pipeline into a csv file

top_n_sets.title: Top N Sets
top_n_sets.description: maximum number of sets to report in padlock_probes.yaml and "padlock_probes_order.yaml"

file_regions.title: File Regions
file_regions.description: file with a list the genes used to generate the probe sequences, leave empty if all the genes are used

files_fasta_target_probe_database.title: Files Fasta Target Probe Database
files_fasta_target_probe_database.description: fasta file with sequences form which the probes should be generated. Hint: use the genomic_region_generator pipeline to create fasta files of genomic regions of interest

files_fasta_reference_database_target_pr.title: Files Fasta Reference Database Target Probe
files_fasta_reference_database_target_pr.description: fasta file with sequences used as reference for the specificity filters. Hint: use the genomic_region_generator pipeline to create fasta files of genomic regions of interest

target_probe_isoform_consensus.title: Target Probe Isoform Consensus
target_probe_isoform_consensus.description: min isoform consesnsus for probes, i.e. how many transcripts of the total number of transcripts of a gene are covered by the probe, given in %

target_probe_GC_content_opt.title: Target Probe Gc Content Opt
target_probe_GC_content_opt.description: max and min values are defiend above

target_probe_GC_weight.title: Target Probe Gc Weight
target_probe_GC_weight.description: weight of the GC content of the probe in the efficiency score

set_size_min.title: Set Size Min
set_size_min.description: minimum size of probe sets (in case there exist no set of the optimal size) -> genes with less oligos will be filtered out and stored in regions_with_insufficient_oligos_for_db_probes

distance_between_target_probes.title: Distance Between Target Probes
distance_between_target_probes.description: how much overlap should be allowed between oligos, e.g. if oligos can overlpap x bases choose -x, if oligos can be next to one another choose 0, if oligos should be x bases apart choose x

n_sets.title: N Sets
n_sets.description: maximum number of sets to generate

max_graph_size.title: Max Graph Size
max_graph_size.description: maximum number of oligos that are taken into consisderation in the last step (5000 -> ~5GB, 2500 -> ~1GB)

n_attempts.title: N Attempts
n_attempts.description: number of attempts to find the optimal set of oligos

heuristic.title: Heuristic
heuristic.description: apply heuristic pre-search to reduce search space and runtime of oligo set selection

heuristic_n_attempts.title: Heuristic N Attempts
heuristic_n_attempts.description: number of attempts to find the optimal set of oligos for heuristic pre-search

target_probe_Tm_opt.title: Target Probe Tm Opt
target_probe_Tm_opt.description: max and min values are defiend above

target_probe_T_secondary_structure.title: Target Probe T Secondary Structure
target_probe_T_secondary_structure.description: Temperature at which the free energy is calculated

target_probe_secondary_structures_thresh.title: Target Probe Secondary Structures Threshold Deltag
target_probe_secondary_structures_thresh.description: threshold for the secondary structure free energy -> oligo rejected if it presents a structure with a negative free energy at the defined temperature

target_probe_isoform_weight.title: Target Probe Isoform Weight
target_probe_isoform_weight.description: weight of the Tm of the probe in the efficiency score

target_probe_Tm_weight.title: Target Probe Tm Weight
target_probe_Tm_weight.description: weight of the Tm of the probe in the efficiency score

files_fasta_reference_database_readout_p.title: Files Fasta Reference Database Readout Probe
files_fasta_reference_database_readout_p.description: fasta file with sequences used as reference for the specificity filters. Hint: use the genomic_region_generator pipeline to create fasta files of genomic regions of interest

n_bits.title: N Bits
n_bits.description: number of bits contained in each barcode

min_hamming_dist.title: Min Hamming Dist
min_hamming_dist.description: minimum distance between two valid barcodes

hamming_weight.title: Hamming Weight
hamming_weight.description: number of bits containing one in each barcode

files_fasta_reference_database_primer.title: Files Fasta Reference Database Primer
files_fasta_reference_database_primer.description: fasta file with sequences used as reference for the specificity filters. Hint: use the genomic_region_generator pipeline to create fasta files of genomic regions of interest

reverse_primer_sequence.title: Reverse Primer Sequence
reverse_primer_sequence.description: defaults to reverse complement of 20 nt T7 promoter sequence, change if different sequence desired

primer_number_three_prime_base_GCclamp.title: Primer Number Three Prime Base Gcclamp

primer_max_len_complement_reverse_primer.title: Primer Max Len Complement Reverse Primer

primer_T_secondary_structure.title: Primer T Secondary Structure
primer_T_secondary_structure.description: Temperature at which the free energy is calculated

primer_secondary_structures_threshold_de.title: Primer Secondary Structures Threshold Deltag
primer_secondary_structures_threshold_de.description: threshold for the secondary structure free energy -> oligo rejected if it presents a structure with a negative free energy at the defined temperature

perc_identity.title: Perc Identity
perc_identity.description: the higher the percent identity is, the more significant the match

strand.title: Strand
strand.description: this parameter is fixed, if reference is whole genome, consider using "both"
